messages.author: 2d2a4f5aa0df3ec7
messages.subject: inla.hyperpar() function is deprecated
parts:
Hi,

I was trying to improve the performance of the INLA estimation using inla.hyperpar(). I was still able to run it yesterday but today it says 
" inla.hyperpar() function is deprecated. Please do not use."

I am wondering if it was the function that was taken off the package or did I do anything wrong with my arguments setting.

Thank you in advance for your time and effort! I look forward to hearing from you soon.
Have a great day.

Best,
Jocelyn

messages.author: 3eab71733027a24a
messages.subject: Re: [r-inla] inla.hyperpar() function is deprecated
parts:
you can still use it if you do not run under the experimental mode, but
its use will be faded out in the future.
